setup.title: Setup wizard
setup.finishHint: Sets setup_completed = true: the wizard is no longer offered at sign-in, and every step can still be changed later.

hint.llm: Which models are used: main (classification and decisions), fast (normalization/sentiment), and twin (clients' digital twins). Keys and provider order are written to .env and applied without a restart; secrets are not returned.
hint.bank: Bank name in templates and on the landing page, client-base size for generation, and region coverage.
hint.sim: Generator seed and event rates per sim-hour. They change only while emulation is stopped; speed is changed in the header.
hint.channels: Which request channels are enabled in the emulation, plus the Mailpit email catcher and the Telegram bot.
hint.policies: Confidence thresholds and HITL rules: when the agent must ask a human, when to escalate, and limits on autonomous refunds. The agent reads them on every run.
hint.sla: 3×3 SLA matrix (fix time, time to take, report days) and routing rules to teams.
hint.economics: dCLTV formula parameters (TZ 14.4), retention factors by outcome, and yield rates. After saving, incident economics are recalculated.
hint.templates: Notification texts by channel and segment, the gift catalog, and digital-twin psychotype shares by segment.
hint.generate: Generate the client base and history (idempotent), review the coverage matrix, and finish setup.

intent.ingest: Accepts the message and links it to the request.
intent.normalize: Detects sentiment and extracts message features.
intent.identify_client: Checks whether the customer can be identified from available data.
intent.gather_context: Collects available transaction and related issue context.
intent.check_rules: Checks applicable business rules and policies.
intent.classify: Determines request type, product and the appropriate team.
intent.decide: Chooses an action and checks whether human approval is needed.
intent.instant_decide: Chooses a fast action under a confirmed business rule.
intent.wait_human: Hands the required decision to a human.
intent.act: Performs permitted actions and records their results.
intent.act_instant: Performs the fast action allowed by a business rule.
intent.verify: Checks that the issue was actually resolved.
intent.close: Completes processing after confirming the result.
intent.gift: Checks and performs an allowed customer reward.
intent.twin_react: Records the twin response to a message visible to the customer.

finance.title: Financial impact
finance.subtitle: Simulation run progress and three calculation variants
finance.timeHint: Periods use simulation time and UTC days. Live covers the selected run. Variants are alternatives and must not be added together.
finance.invalidDates: Enter both dates; the end must be after the start.
finance.incomplete: Incomplete: {{missing}} cases have no calculation, {{stale}} are stale. Totals are provisional.
finance.estimate: Model estimate based on outcomes and retention factors. This is not verified revenue.
finance.scenarioHint: User assumption, not NLP output. One identified client per case × probability × (dCLTV + premium addon); no client means 0. Repeat cases may overlap.
finance.fineHint: Cases with manager decision go: {{count}}. Fine is an assumption for resolved misselling cases; go does not prove a fine was avoided. Excluded from the main total.
finance.empty: No resolved cases in this period.

financeProof.title: Data-based assessment: demo and observed
financeProof.boundary: Contours are separate and must not be added together. Risk uses the first resolved case per client per run; refunds cover all cases. This is a model estimate, not proof of the agent’s causal impact.

scopeHint.demo: Reproducible synthetic scores and control outcomes test the calibration mechanism, not real NLP quality. Horizon: 7 simulation days.
scopeHint.observed: Requires labelled control outcomes and approvals. Demo data and hypothetical fines are excluded.

financeProof.coverage: Clients with estimate: {{known}}; unknown: {{unknown}}; unidentified cases: {{unidentified}}; repeat cases: {{duplicates}}.
financeProof.partial: Known portion: {{amount}}. Missing totals are not replaced with zero.
financeProof.noCalibration: No admitted calibration dataset for this contour.
financeProof.noPolicy: No approved fine policy for this contour.
financeProof.recordHint: An operator declaration with a source reference, not verification of legal authority. Times use simulation UTC. Deal closure means the process ended with the stated outcome. A new version replaces the previous estimate for that deal.

hints.default: Explain the next step and agree on a convenient contact channel.
hints.loyal_pragmatic: Explain the facts and the outcome briefly; avoid unnecessary promises.
hints.anxious: Confirm that the issue has been noticed, explain the next step and provide regular updates.
hints.demanding_rational: Provide reasons, specific deadlines and facts; honour commitments.
hints.public_emotional: Respond promptly and calmly, acknowledge the inconvenience and offer a private channel for details.
hints.silent_churner: Contact the customer proactively: do not wait for a complaint; offer a clear next step.
hints.bonus_hunter: Explain the terms and suitable compensation; do not promise a gift before approval.
hints.novice: Explain in plain language, step by step; check that the customer understands the solution.
hints.status_oriented: Offer personal support, precise deadlines and a named contact.
